name: llms-txt-generator
title: llms.txt generator
description: Reads a site's sitemap and drafts an llms.txt file in the standard layout: a title, a short summary and sections of Markdown links.

siteName.title: Site name (optional)
siteName.description: Used as the title. Defaults to the page title.

summary.title: One-line summary (optional)
summary.description: Defaults to the homepage meta description.
